description: Halbert RAG corpus - Cleaned, schema-normalized, and deduplicated Linux, macOS, BSD, and Common system administration knowledge base

arch_wiki.description: Arch Linux Wiki - comprehensive Linux documentation (hannah-eee dataset and curated extensions)

linux_man_pages.description: Linux man pages - command reference documentation (backspaces stripped, fragments removed, deduped)

tldr_pages.description: TLDR simplified command summaries across Common, Linux, macOS, and BSD platforms

common_tools.description: Cross-platform core tools (git, devtools, shell, python, docker, containers, aws-cli)

linux_system_docs.description: Linux system guides (systemd, networking, security, storage, backup, monitoring, kernel)

vendor_and_distro_docs.description: Vendor and distro documentation (Docker, K8s, Helm, NVIDIA, ROCm, Ubuntu)

macos_homebrew.description: Homebrew package manager documentation - formulas, casks, and official docs

macos_man_pages.description: macOS man pages extracted from local system - command reference (deduped, clean)

macos_support.description: Halbert-authored macOS command references (87 commands) and troubleshooting guides (APFS, Apple Silicon, notarization, MDM, recovery, user management, software update, Spotlight, diagnostics). Original content, no third-party text.
macos_support.note: SS64 (CC BY-NC 4.0) content was quarantined out of this path on 2026-08-25 (LEG-CRIT-01) into non-commercial/macos_ss64/. macos_command_guides.jsonl is the Halbert-authored replacement and provides 100% command coverage; regenerate it with scripts/generate_macos_command_guides.py.

macos_ask_different.description: Ask Different (apple.stackexchange.com) high-voted Q&A with accepted answers - macOS troubleshooting, networking, security, hardware

macos_macports_guide.description: MacPorts Guide - package management, portfile development, and project guidelines

freebsd_handbook.description: FreeBSD Handbook - comprehensive BSD documentation covering networking, storage, security, and system administration.

freebsd_man_pages.description: FreeBSD man pages for BSD commands shared with macOS - user commands, system admin, file formats

macos_ss64_noncommercial.description: SS64.com macOS command reference. QUARANTINED: non-commercial licence, excluded from every paid channel. Replaced for shipping purposes by the Halbert-authored references in macos/support/macos_command_guides.jsonl.
macos_ss64_noncommercial.note: Enforced by config/licensing.yml (record_quarantine: ss64-macos) and scripts/corpus_license_gate.py. Never add this path to a build target.

mac_build_exclusions: All sources with mac_build: false are excluded from macOS builds
GNU FDL content (Arch Wiki) is excluded from macOS builds: strong copyleft, and GFDL 1.3 §2 forbids the technical measures the Mac App Store applies
Linux-only sources (man pages, system docs, vendor docs) never reach a macOS build: macOS ships data/macos + data/bsd + data/common only
See documentation/legal/ for the full licensing audit and action plan
attribution_requirements: Stack Exchange content requires CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution
TLDR content requires CC BY 4.0 attribution
SS64 content requires CC BY-NC 4.0 attribution and is non-commercial only
FreeBSD Handbook requires FreeBSD Documentation License attribution
macOS man pages: BSD pages require BSD attribution, Apple pages require APSL 2.0
commercial_exclusions: CC BY-NC 4.0 content (non-commercial/macos_ss64/) is excluded from every commercial channel: macos-pro (LemonSqueezy) and macos-app-store
Halbert-authored replacements provide 100% coverage of the excluded commands
Enforced at build time by scripts/corpus_license_gate.py
licensing_policy: Channels: oss-linux, oss-macos, macos-pro, macos-app-store, hf-dataset
